Soon it will be too late.
The meat is frozen, crisp and red.
Turn our head to use our back teeth to scissor it from the bones.
A crow flies down, lands on the snow nearby.
For sport, we lunge at him, put him to flight again.
We put back our ears, but still we hear him, come, come, come.
He steals the pleasure from the meat with his whining.
We have eaten enough for now.
We will go, just to still him.
Come to me, come to me.
We go, trotting through the gathering darkness.
A rabbit sits up suddenly, scampers away across the snow.
Cross a man’s path, an open empty strip under the night sky.
We fade across it swiftly, trot on through the woods that border it.
There is a cleared hillside below us, and beyond that a flat, bare place, shelterless under the night sky.
The crusted snow is untracked, but at the bottom of the hill, there are humans.
Heart of the Pack digs while another watches.
Heart of the Pack digs fast and hard.
His breath smokes in the night.
The other has a light, a too-bright light that shrinks the eye to behold.
Heart of the Pack stops his digging.
He jumps into the hole he has dug.
There is black earth, frozen chunks of it, on top of the clean snow.
He lands with a thud like deer antlers on a tree.
He crouches and there is a tearing sound.
He uses a tool that thuds and tears.
We settle down to watch him, wrapping tail around to warm front feet.
What has this to do with us?
We are full, we could go sleep now.
He looks up at us suddenly through the night.

Nighteyes. Changer. Heart of the Pack summons you.

We pause again. Shake all over. This is not comfortable. And what is Heart of the Pack to us? He is not pack. He pushes us. There is meat closer. It is decided. We go to the pond’s edge. Here. Somewhere here. Ah. Dig down to her through the snow. The crows come to watch us, waiting for us to be finished.
Nighteyes. Changer. Come. Come now. Soon it will be too late.

The meat is frozen, crisp and red. Turn our head to use our back teeth to scissor it from the bones. A crow flies down, lands on the snow nearby. Hop, hop. He cocks his head. For sport, we lunge at him, put him to flight again. Our meat, all of it. Days and nights of meat.
Come. Please. Come. Please. Come soon, come now. Come back to us. You are needed. Come. Come.

He does not go away. We put back our ears, but still we hear him, come, come, come. He steals the pleasure from the meat with his whining. Enough. We have eaten enough for now. We will go, just to still him.
Good. That’s good. Come to me, come to me.

We go, trotting through the gathering darkness. A rabbit sits up suddenly, scampers away across the snow. Shall we? No. Belly is full. Trot on. Cross a man’s path, an open empty strip under the night sky. We fade across it swiftly, trot on through the woods that border it.
Come to me. Come. Nighteyes, Changer, I summon you. Come to me.

The forest ends. There is a cleared hillside below us, and beyond that a flat, bare place, shelterless under the night sky. Too open. The crusted snow is untracked, but at the bottom of the hill, there are humans. Two. Heart of the Pack digs while another watches. Heart of the Pack digs fast and hard. His breath smokes in the night. The other has a light, a too-bright light that shrinks the eye to behold. Heart of the Pack stops his digging. He looks up at us.

He jumps into the hole he has dug. There is black earth, frozen chunks of it, on top of the clean snow. He lands with a thud like deer antlers on a tree. He crouches and there is a tearing sound. He uses a tool that thuds and tears. We settle down to watch him, wrapping tail around to warm front feet. What has this to do with us? We are full, we could go sleep now. He looks up at us suddenly through the night.

Ночной Волк. Изменяющий. Сердце Стаи зовёт тебя.

Иди. Пожалуйста. Иди. Пожалуйста. Иди скорее, иди сейчас. Вернись к нам. Ты нужен. Иди. Иди.
Он не уходит. Мы прижимаем уши, но всё равно слышим его: иди, иди, иди. Он своим нытьём крадёт удовольствие от мяса. Довольно. На сей раз мы съели достаточно. Мы пойдём, лишь бы он умолк.
Хорошо. Вот и хорошо. Иди ко мне, иди ко мне.

Мы идём, труся сквозь сгущающуюся темноту. Кролик вдруг садится столбиком, затем удирает по снегу. Может? Нет. Брюхо полно. Трусить дальше. Пересечь человеческую дорогу, открытую пустую полосу под ночным небом. Мы быстро растворяемся на ней, трусим дальше через лес, окаймляющий её.
Иди ко мне. Иди. Ночной Волк, Изменяющий, я призываю тебя. Иди ко мне.

Лес кончается. Под нами расчищенный склон холма, а за ним — ровное голое место, без укрытия под ночным небом. Слишком открыто. Наст на снегу не тронут следами, но внизу холма есть люди. Двое. Сердце Стаи копает, пока другой смотрит. Сердце Стаи копает быстро и яростно. Его дыхание дымится в ночи. У другого есть свет, слишком яркий свет, от которого глаз сжимается. Сердце Стаи перестаёт копать. Он смотрит на нас.

Он прыгает в выкопанную им яму. На чистом снегу лежит чёрная земля, мёрзлые её комья. Он приземляется с глухим стуком, как оленьи рога о дерево. Он приседает, и слышится треск разрываемого. Он работает орудием, которое глухо стучит и рвёт. Мы устраиваемся наблюдать, оборачивая хвост вокруг передних лап, чтобы согреть их. Что нам до этого? Мы сыты, могли бы теперь пойти спать. Он вдруг глядит на нас сквозь ночь.

paragraphPairs.sourceText: He jumps into the hole he has dug. There is black earth, frozen chunks of it, on top of the clean snow. He lands with a thud like deer antlers on a tree.
